messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — P12345 for service=autoscaler-controller: sustained 5xx spike + repeated page loop. link: https://pagerduty.example/P12345 — runbook: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/autoscaler#duplicates

maria: ack — taking this. opening a quick bridge. @pagerbot please mute duplicate noise while we triage :pray:

jonah: ack from me but on a call. what's the immediate customer impact?

maria: short version: embeddings-inference (us-west) seeing ~7% 502/503 for last 5m. retries from the gateway and autoscaler thrash are causing duplicate PD pages. spike aligns with canary deploy at ~10:12.

alex: seeing HPA oscillations in the same window — scale events ~every 20–40s. metric looks noisy (queue_length metric). probable metric flapping feeding the autoscaler.

maria: can we patch stabilization window quickly?

alex: yep. proposed quick patch: set stabilizationWindowSeconds to 300 and minReplicas=3. will apply now: 
```bash
kubectl patch hpa embeddings -n prod --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3,"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":300}}}}'
```

maria: applying now from ops jump host.

pagerbot: Muting PagerDuty alerts for P12345 for 20 minutes per request by maria (oncall). mute-id=mute-9988.

jonah: can we also throttle gateway retries as a short-term mitigation? maybe cap to 1 retry or add jitter.

maria: good call. temporary gateway header cap in-flight: adding `X-Retry-Max: 1` via a quick config push.

maria: rolling back the canary as a precaution: 
```bash
./deploy rollback --service embeddings-canary --to=prev
```

shaun: i'll take follow-through ownership (post-deploy tuning + verification). ETA ~30m to tune autoscaler behavior and confirm <1% errors. leaving bridge open.

maria: handing off to shaun. if errors don't fall under 1% in 10m ping me and i'll rejoin.

shaun: ack — on it. initial metrics after HPA patch: errors down from 7.2% -> 3.8% (5m). continuing to monitor. will post status updates every 5m.

maria: thanks. i'm stepping back but reachable if needed. :heart:

incident-bot: PagerDuty update — P12345 acknowledged by maria, reassigned to shaun for remediation.

shaun: quick actions taken: tuned HPA behavior (stabilization + smoothing), lowered gateway retry budget, rolled back canary. current error rate: 1.1% at +18m. continuing 10m verification window. created follow-up ENG-2029 to address metric smoothing and canary guardrails.

maria: great. once stable <1% for 10m we can resolve. i'll add a note to the runbook about auto-muting duplicate pages during autoscaler oscillation and a playbook step to check recent canary deploys.

pagerbot: P12345 status changed to resolved by shaun (manual resolve after conditions met).

jonah: thanks everyone. tidy handoff. please add monitoring alert to detect HPA chatter and auto-suppress PD duplicates next time. :thumbsup:

maria: will do, logging follow-up and a short retro. closing thread.
